description: Every chaos layer and the settings it accepts, for every language. A setting ending in Rate is a probability from 0 to 1; rejectStatus is a whole HTTP status from 400 to 599; the others are non-negative numbers (the unit is in the name). The C# library (ChaosScenario.Known) and the TypeScript library (KNOWN_LAYERS) each hold a copy and each test suite checks its copy against this file, so a layer or setting cannot exist in one and not the other. A process applies the layers it has an interface for and reports the rest as not applicable.
sectionsDescription: Optional sections of a scenario file besides name, seed and layers. where: per layer, the matches (operation, customer, key, payload, ADR-0024 amendment) a layer is limited to. off: layers that start switched off. signals: normal requests that match a rule and then enable or disable a layer, switch to another scenario file, or reset the counters. failFirstAttempts (bffCatalog, bffOrdering) is a whole number: the first that many attempts of each operation and key fail. The Node processes apply all of these; the C# library checks them and does not apply them.
